enchantments.tooltip: Greater Heroism: Passive: +4 morale bonus to all your attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks. Does not grant immunity to Fear.
Charisma +14: This item makes the wearer have more flair, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Charisma.
Combat Mastery +11: +11 Enhancement bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +56 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
